description: Targeted regression check for step 6's compose/confirm/commit split (retro S03)

evals.name: Each wave's commit gets its own confirmation before running
evals.prompt: Using standalone-commits, stage and commit Wave 2 of a 3-wave sequence (files already staged, claim already written).
evals.expected_output: Step 6 composes the message per commit skill's format (linking, not restating, the footer table), then shows the exact composed message via a distinct AskUserQuestion ('Commit this wave with this message?' with options including 'Commit as shown' / 'Revise the message' / 'Stop') BEFORE the marker is written or git commit runs. The marker write happens only after the confirmation, immediately before git commit.
